credentials: PHD 2000 Univ Of NC At Chapel Hill
name: HONGMING ZHANG

ratings.comment: great prof. obviously knows his stuff and has the publications to back that. that being said, he packs a lot into every lecture and it can be overwhelming, however he is very clear about expectations and no surprises on the exams at all.
Wonderful professor and an even better person. Expansive knowledge not only of Chinese language, but also Chinese culture.

I really appreciate how structured the lectures and discussions are! The course is super well organized and HMZ has a really good attitude and is super enthusiastic. The one thing that kind of bothers me is that after 3 unexcused absences one point is taken off your final grade for every class you miss and I think that is a little excessive.

The class is well structured and organized, and its an easy A. But attendance is super important to your grade; if you miss more than 3 discussions or lectures (and you have discussion every day, its automatically a percentage off your final grade. Hes an ok professor, and lectures can be really dull.

HMZ is highly organized and lectures very well. For the first half of the course, I didn't find reading necessary because HMZ's lectures are so comprehensive (it quickly becomes necessary). HMZ tears apart the dialogues in the required readings to emphasize  grammatical points and new vocab, which is very useful as the course is mostly a self-study
HMZ is awesome. Take for a free A if you already have some Chinese experience. Also highly amusing.

Easy class, taught by TA's, but after I had him for 2 semesters HE DROVE ME CRAZY. He uses a lot of linguistics lingo (he teaches a Chi linguistics class too), and the same phrases OVER AND OVER (he uses "adverbial" a lot). If you sit in the front, he'll like stare at you for the class becuase you are a "good student." TAs rock though, loved them!

As long as you attend class and learn to write the characters, you will get an A.  The class is pretty much entirely taught by the TAs.  But they are funny and laid back and you still manage to learn a lot.  Easy A for this class, and he is the best teacher ever.
